reading.body:
This record flags a misclassification and does not qualify as a data center campus. Forescout Technologies describes itself on its published site as a cybersecurity software company built around its Vistaro platform for asset visibility and compliance, not as a physical data center operator. No facility address, square footage, or power capacity appears on the operator's homepage, and the San Jose address in this registry entry is a corporate office location, not a published operating facility.

The entry has been flagged for human review rather than deleted, because the registry's mapping process identified it through geographic coordinates that could plausibly refer to a real facility. A person must decide whether to repoint the record to an actual operating data center, correct the operator type, or remove it entirely.

Until that review is complete, this entry contributes no verified capacity data to the count of AI-relevant infrastructure in California. The state has 11 facilities with published megawatt figures totaling 365 MW across 103 mapped locations.
